records.prompt:

Input2 (Mio's previous sprite) is ONLY her identity, hairstyle, outfit and pose guide. The old woman's clean anime facial rendering is precisely the problem to fix.
Redraw her from the original strokes with the SAME weight and broken irregularity of contours, opaque coarse brushwork, uneven pigment coverage and strong hard-edged asymmetric shadow masses seen on Minato's face and jacket. Put real deep grey-ochre shadow planes across one side of her cheek, eye socket, under hair and neck. Use sparse broad patches, lost edges, dry-brush marks, not an even geometric mosaic texture. No airbrush, delicate fashion illustration, glossy skin, shiny lips, immaculate big-eyed modern anime beauty, watercolor wash, uniform grain overlay, sepia filter or merely lowering brightness of Input2. Her face must have the SAME ink-and-paint vocabulary as Minato while preserving her own feminine bone structure, gentle intelligent eyes and 32-year-old adulthood. Avoid transferring his masculine jaw, stubble, extreme fatigue, glasses or suit. Eyes modest natural size; warm quiet closed-mouth normal expression, not glamor posing.
Maintain loose long DARK BROWN WAVY hair, light dusty BLUE blazer, off-white modest blouse, pale blue-grey CALF-LENGTH SKIRT, grey pumps, delicate small earrings/pendant/watch. No ponytail or trousers. Keep recognizably her face; retain graceful everyday intelligence and slightly lighter clothing palette than Minato, but paint her skin and cloth roughly and with equally decisive dark shadows. Clothes are matte, worn naturally without dirt or damage.
Match Input2's shallow three-quarter standing direction towards screen LEFT, hands loosely overlapped low in front, normal neutral stance. Complete head through BOTH shoe soles, single centered figure with clear margin on portrait1024x1536, identical format to Minato. Truly transparent outside the figure, no paper backdrop, haze, bloom, shadows on ground, environment, text, sheet panels or extra people. This is a prototype for matching original drawing touch, not a finished expression sheet.
